verse.verse_2: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
verse.verse_3: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
verse.verse_4: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
verse.verse_5: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
verse.verse_7: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
verse.verse_8: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
verse.verse_11: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
verse.verse_12: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
verse.verse_13: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
verse.verse_14: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
verse.verse_17: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
verse.verse_18: From what stuff hath He created him?
verse.verse_19: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
verse.verse_20: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
verse.verse_21: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
verse.verse_22: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
verse.verse_23: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
verse.verse_24: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
verse.verse_25: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
verse.verse_26: And We split the earth in fragments,
verse.verse_30: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
verse.verse_32: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
verse.verse_33: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
verse.verse_34: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
verse.verse_35: And from his mother and his father,
verse.verse_36: And from his wife and his children.
verse.verse_37: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
verse.verse_38: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
verse.verse_40: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
verse.verse_42: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
